arabic text: NA RAKH AB CHADAR BAZUO PE\nTU NEELE DAAGH CHUPA NAI\nZAHRA KI JAA'N SHARMA NAI
english translation text: O ZAINAB! DON’T BE AFRAID TO EXPLAIN THE PAIN INFLICTED UPON YOU,\nO ZAINAB! DON’T BE AFRAID TO DESCRIBE THE SCARS THIS PAIN HAS LEFT

arabic text: TERE NANA KA YE ROZA HAI\nKOI KUFA SHAAM KI RAAH NAI\nZAHRA KI JAA'N SHARMA NAI
english translation text: YOU ARE AT THE GRAVE OF YOUR GRANDFATHER,\nNOT IN THE STREETS OF KUFA OR SHAAM,

arabic text: JO CHADAR UJLI THI TERI RANG USKA KAISE LAAL HUA..\nAB SAR PE TERE AYE SHEHZADI, WO KYU MAUJOOD RIDA NAI
english translation text: O BIBI! HOW DID YOU VEIL TURN RED?\nO PRINCESS, HOW DID YOU LOSE YOUR VEIL?

arabic text: ATTHARA JO TERE BHAI THE KIS BAAT PE TUJHSE ROOTH GAYE\nDO SHEHZADE KYU SAATH NAHI, KYU SAATH ABBAS TERA NAI
english translation text: O BIBI! YOU HAD 18 BROTHERS, WHERE HAVE THEY ALL GONE?\nWHY AREN’T YOUR TWO YOUNG PRINCES NOR ABBAS WITH YOU?

arabic text: YE KAUN JAWAAN HAI SAATH TERE HAI KAPDE JISKE KHOO'N SE BHARE..\nIN ZAKHMO SE YE CHOOR HUA, AANKHO'N SE BHI KHOO RUKTA NAI
english translation text: WHO IS THIS YOUNG MAN WITH YOU WHOSE CLOTHES ARE FULL OF BLOOD?\nHIS BODY IS COVERED IN WOUNDS, AND THERE IS BLOOD FLOWING FROM HIS EYES AS WELL

arabic text: KIS HAAL MEIN KARBAL SE AAYI AYE ZAINAB APNE SHEHR MEIN TU\nAB ISKE SIWA AFSOS HAI KYA, PEHCHAAN SAKI SUGHRA NAI
english translation text: O ZAINAB, YOU ARRIVED BACK IN MADINA FROM KARBALA IN SUCH A STATE, THAT TRAGICALLY EVEN SUGHRA DID NOT RECOGNISE YOU

arabic text: WO BACCHI JISKO SEENE PE SHABBIR SULAYA KARTE THE\nMERI AAKHEIN DHUNDH KE HAAR GAYI, KAHI'N MILTA USKA PATA NAI
english translation text: WHERE IS THAT CHILD WHOM HUSAIN USED TO PUT TO SLEEP ON HIS CHEST?\nMY EYES HAVE GOT TIRED LOOKING FOR HER, BUT I CANNOT FIND HER ANYWHERE
